$comment: Which skill to read when an automated audit reports a given axe rule.
Most rules map to more than one criterion, and every criterion maps to several
skills, so deriving this by joining the two tables produces thirteen suggestions
for one finding. This file is the missing judgement: one primary skill per rule.
It is not taken on trust. verify/verify-skills.js checks that every rule id here
is a real axe rule (from the committed snapshot in verify/axe-rules.json), that
every named skill exists, and that the skill actually declares one of the
criteria the rule tests. A guess that does not line up fails CI.
Rules axe ships disabled by default are marked, because a finding from one of
them means the auditor enabled it deliberately - not that axe checks it for you.
Rules with no entry are genuine gaps: docs/RULE-MAP.md lists them, the CLI
prints 'no skill yet', and they are the backlog.

area-alt.why: an image map's areas are links, so they need link text

aria-allowed-attr.why: an attribute the role does not support: review the widget's ARIA

aria-braille-equivalent.why: braille-only attributes must still carry a spoken name

aria-command-name.why: a role=button/menuitem/link has no accessible name

aria-conditional-attr.why: an attribute is present in a state that forbids it

aria-deprecated-role.why: the role was removed from ARIA; use the native element

aria-hidden-body.why: aria-hidden on <body> hides the whole page from assistive tech

aria-hidden-focus.why: something focusable is inside aria-hidden and stays reachable by Tab

aria-input-field-name.why: an ARIA textbox/combobox/slider has no accessible name

aria-meter-name.why: a meter needs a name that says what it measures

aria-progressbar-name.why: a progressbar needs an accessible name, not just a percentage

aria-prohibited-attr.why: the role prohibits this attribute, usually aria-label on a generic role

aria-required-attr.why: the role is incomplete without a required state attribute

aria-required-children.why: a composite role is missing the children its structure requires

aria-required-parent.why: a child role is used outside the parent that gives it meaning

aria-roledescription.why: a custom role description needs a valid role and a visible label

aria-roles.why: the role value is not a real ARIA role

aria-tab-name.why: a tab needs an accessible name

aria-toggle-field-name.why: an ARIA checkbox/switch/radio has no accessible name

aria-tooltip-name.why: a tooltip needs an accessible name

aria-valid-attr.why: an aria-* attribute name does not exist

aria-valid-attr-value.why: an ARIA attribute value is invalid or points at a missing id

audio-caption.why: an audio element has no track with kind=captions

autocomplete-valid.why: the autocomplete token is not one of the defined values

blink.why: a blinking element cannot be paused

button-name.why: a button has no accessible name, usually an icon-only button

bypass.why: no skip link, heading or landmark to bypass repeated content

color-contrast.why: text contrast is below 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text

color-contrast-enhanced.why: AAA contrast, 7:1 for body text - axe leaves this rule off by default

css-orientation-lock.why: content is locked to one orientation

definition-list.why: a dl contains elements that are not dt, dd or a valid wrapper

dlitem.why: a dt/dd sits outside a dl

document-title.why: the page has no title, or an empty one

duplicate-id-aria.why: duplicate ids break the aria-labelledby/controls references to them

form-field-multiple-labels.why: a field has more than one label element, so its name is ambiguous

frame-focusable-content.why: a frame's content is focusable but unreachable inside a scrollable region

frame-title.why: an iframe has no title attribute

frame-title-unique.why: two iframes share a title, so they cannot be told apart

html-has-lang.why: the html element has no lang attribute

html-lang-valid.why: the lang value is not a valid language subtag

image-alt.why: an img has no alt, or no role to say it is decorative

input-button-name.why: an input type=button/submit has no value to serve as its name

input-image-alt.why: an input type=image has no alt

label.why: a form control has no associated label

label-content-name-mismatch.why: the visible text is not part of the accessible name, breaking voice control

link-in-text-block.why: an inline link is distinguished by colour alone

link-name.why: a link has no accessible name, or one that says nothing

list.why: a ul/ol contains elements that are not li

listitem.why: an li sits outside a ul/ol/menu

meta-refresh.why: the page refreshes itself with no way to stop it

meta-viewport.why: user-scalable=no or a maximum-scale blocks pinch zoom

nested-interactive.why: interactive elements are nested inside an interactive parent

no-autoplay-audio.why: audio plays longer than 3 seconds with no way to stop it

object-alt.why: an object element has no text alternative

p-as-heading.why: a bold, enlarged paragraph is used where a heading belongs

scrollable-region-focusable.why: a scrollable region is not reachable without a mouse

select-name.why: a select has no accessible name

server-side-image-map.why: a server-side image map has no keyboard equivalent

summary-name.why: a summary has no accessible name

svg-img-alt.why: an inline SVG in the image role has no accessible name

table-fake-caption.why: a table uses a styled cell instead of a caption element

target-size.why: SC 2.5.8 target size - axe leaves this rule off by default

td-has-header.why: a data cell has no header to be associated with

td-headers-attr.why: the headers attribute points at cells that are not headers, or outside the table

th-has-data-cells.why: a header row or column describes no data cells

valid-lang.why: a lang attribute on an element is not a valid language subtag

video-caption.why: a video element has no captions track

accesskeys.why: a duplicated accesskey collides with another shortcut

aria-allowed-role.why: the element does not accept this role, or the role conflicts with it

aria-dialog-name.why: a dialog has no accessible name

aria-text.why: role=text has no focusable children, so it hides structure for nothing

aria-treeitem-name.why: a treeitem has no accessible name

empty-heading.why: a heading has no text, so heading navigation lands nowhere

empty-table-header.why: a header cell has no text

focus-order-semantics.why: a focusable element has a role that does not accept focus

heading-order.why: heading levels are out of order - a best practice, not a WCAG failure

image-redundant-alt.why: the alt repeats adjacent text, so screen readers hear it twice

label-title-only.why: a field is labelled only by title or placeholder, and loses its name

landmark-banner-is-top-level.why: a banner landmark is nested and so not exposed

landmark-complementary-is-top-level.why: a complementary landmark is nested and so not exposed

landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level.why: a contentinfo landmark is nested and so not exposed

landmark-main-is-top-level.why: a main landmark is nested, making skip-to-main ambiguous

landmark-no-duplicate-banner.why: more than one banner landmark on the page

landmark-no-duplicate-contentinfo.why: more than one contentinfo landmark on the page

landmark-no-duplicate-main.why: more than one main landmark on the page

landmark-one-main.why: the page has no main landmark

landmark-unique.why: two landmarks of the same role have the same name

meta-viewport-large.why: maximum-scale limits zoom to less than 5x

presentation-role-conflict.why: role=presentation is ignored because the element is focusable or global

region.why: content sits outside every landmark - a best practice, not a WCAG failure

scope-attr-valid.why: the scope attribute value is invalid or misapplied

skip-link.why: a skip link target is missing, not focusable, or not in the DOM order

tabindex.why: a positive tabindex reorders the whole page's focus sequence

table-duplicate-name.why: the table's caption and summary say the same thing
